name: Asumi Kominami
source:
Asumi likes to tease Nariyuki Yuiga just for fun, although her jokes are usually harmless.

She will do anything that she can to pretend that she and Nariyuki love each other.

She hates to be referred to as a "repeater" or mistaken as a middle schooler.

[From [url=https://weneverlearn.fandom.com/wiki/Asumi_Kominami]We Never Learn Wiki[/url]]
